features.description: cost-model skill at claude/skills/cost-model/. Reads ~/.jarvis/quota_state.json (LLM tokens) + dashboard/state/costs.json (GCP $) + (optional) dashboard/state/revenue.json (when F003 has run). Projects month-end and next-month spend per app and per LLM provider using straight-line trajectory from week-to-date / month-to-date burn. Writes a markdown report + machine-readable JSON to evidence/<run-id>/cost-model-<ts>.{md,json}. Pure read; no mutation of inputs. Conforms to claude/shared/skill-standard/CONFORMANCE.md. Registered in claude/RESOLVER.md.

features.description: cost-guard skill at claude/skills/cost-guard/. Reads costs.json + quota_state.json + config/cost_budgets.json (new template file with sentinel zeros). Compares observed run-rate to per-app warn_threshold (default 80%) and breach_threshold (default 100%) for both GCP $ and LLM tokens. On breach or warn, appends a structured entry to the existing INBOX.md surface owned by F008 (kind: cost_warn or cost_breach). Idempotent within a calendar week — same (app, threshold_kind, week_start) tuple deduplicates. Stale-data guard: state files >24h old emit data_stale finding instead of false-positive breach. Conforms to claude/shared/skill-standard/CONFORMANCE.md. Registered in claude/RESOLVER.md.
steps: Create config/cost_budgets.json template with apps: Styln, Spin & Dine, QuantRE/Axiom, Jarvis — gcp_monthly_budget_usd: 0, llm_weekly_token_budget: 0 (sentinel zeros)

Implement idempotency: dedupe key = sha256(f'{app}|{kind}|{week_start_iso}'); skill maintains state/cost_guard_seen.json (gitignored) to avoid duplicate INBOX entries within a week
Implement stale-data check: compare quota_state.json `generated` and costs.json `generated` to now; if >24h, emit data_stale and short-circuit
Implement zero-budget short-circuit: if all budgets in config are 0, emit single `no_budgets_configured` finding and exit 0

features.description: revenue-check skill at claude/skills/revenue-check/. Pulls product revenue per app from app-specific Firestore collections (Glam: creatorEngagementEvents + commerce subscription docs from Phase J0-J7; SpinDine: per D001 recon — fallback is documented stub). Aggregates to monthly revenue per app. Writes dashboard/state/revenue.json (NEW; outside the protected dirty-files list). Produces a cash-flow markdown report that reads costs.json + revenue.json and computes net = revenue − cost per app. Read-only against Firestore; uses existing firebase_client.py + ADC. Stub-mode runs entirely from fixtures so fresh-clone tests need no credentials.

Live execution is reachable only via explicit `--live` and requires ADC for Firestore-backed apps; tests exercise FixtureAdapter + DeferredAdapter + adapter resolver + a no-credentials `--live` deferred-app CLI path.
